item.title: Show HN: Kanban-md – File-based CLI Kanban built for local agents collaboration
item.description:
📝 kanban-md An agents-first file-based Kanban. Installable via kanban-md skill install. # Initialize a board in the current directory kanban-md init --name "My Project" # Create some tasks kanban-md create "Set up CI pipeline" --priority high --tags devops kanban-md create "Write API docs" --assignee alice --due 2026-03-01 kanban-md create "Fix login bug" --status todo --priority critical # List all tasks kanban-md list # Filter and sort kanban-md list --status todo,in-progress --sort priority --reverse # Move a task forward kanban-md move 3 in-progress kanban-md move 3 --next # Edit a task kanban-md edit 2 --add-tag documentation --body "Cover all REST endpoints" # View task details kanban-md show 1 # Done with a task kanban-md move 1 done # Or delete it kanban-md delete 3 --yes How it works Running kanban-md init creates a kanban/ directory: kanban/ config.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/antopolskiy/kanban-md
